title: Ada and the Bridge
author: Ines Winterbourne
blurb: Sable Dravenmoor, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
